hints.content:
Let's find the constant  of proportionality.   

In the proportional relationship between $w$ and $z$, one constant of proportionality is the number we multiply by $w$ to get $z$.

$w\, \times\,  ?=z$

$w$ | $z$ | Relationship 
:-: | :-: | :-:
$18$ | $2$ | ${18}\times\blueD{\dfrac19}=2$
$45$ | $5$ | ${45}\times\blueD{\dfrac19}=5$
$81$ | $9$ |  ${81}\times\blueD{\dfrac19}=9$

The constant of proportionality is $\blueD{\dfrac19}$.  This means we can multiply $\blueD{\dfrac19}$ by $w$ to get $z$.

Now, let's represent that as an equation.  

$\begin{align}
{z}&=\blueD{\text{constant of proportionality}}\times{w} \\\\
{z}&=\blueD{\dfrac19}w
\end{align}$
